Allocating Memory and Launching Processes

For information about how the Process Manager launches your application, see
the chapter "Process Manager" in Inside Macintosh: Processes. See the chapter "Introduction to Memory Management" in Inside Macintosh: Memory for informa-
tion about how system software manages memory; how you can manage the memory
in your application's partition effectively; and how your application can allocate, release, or manipulate memory.
